limits: Direct fit to one recording; no unseen-note or velocity test.

No waveform playback or recorded envelopes at runtime.
Late check shares the same filtered source; not independent validation.

spectral_proxy.scope: First three windows; reference band SNR >=18 dB. Listening decides timbre.
